name: Auction Trading System Data 1
definition: Data related to the auction trading system for the pre-trade output report.

IndicativePriceDateTime.name: Indicative Price Date Time
IndicativePriceDateTime.definition: Most recent dates and times of the prices that participate in the Consolidated Tape Provider (CTP)’s indicative auction price as reported by the data contributors.

AuctionPrice.name: Auction Price
AuctionPrice.definition: Data related to the auction price for the auction trading system.

AuctionVolume.name: Auction Volume
AuctionVolume.definition: Total auction volume, where applicable, across venues.
